'''Sluis Sector Command''' was an organization affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that operated within the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. The Command established supply runs to the [[Defiant Core]] base on [[Innton II]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
